question: How much is recoverable from the duplex itself?
candidates_or_measurements: Whole-duplex sequence and predicted secondary structure
control_or_reference: Compact AdarEdit sequence--structure graph; pair-disjoint benchmark
principal_outcome: Substantial within-context signal; transfer is structured but not universal
disposition: Reference for all incremental tests

question: Does genomic organization add information absent from the folded graph?
candidates_or_measurements: Inter-arm gap, span, arm geometry, graph summaries, edited-site burden
control_or_reference: Geometry plus graph summaries versus graph summaries alone; shuffled targets
principal_outcome: Geometry adds reproducible between-substrate burden signal in all four tissues
disposition: Retain biological result; not a selected site feature

question: Do broad static annotations improve individual-site prediction?
candidates_or_measurements: Repeat subfamily/divergence/neighborhood and transcript/exon/intron annotations
control_or_reference: Same-fold baseline-logit residual models; matched random block
principal_outcome: No stable residual increment beyond the graph representation
disposition: Close tested site-level formulation

question: Do fixed sites change across tissue contexts?
candidates_or_measurements: Matched-site EditingIndex, strict edited/nonedited switches, matched-site pair summaries
control_or_reference: Same genomic sites across four individual tissues; Combined excluded
principal_outcome: Tissue-dependent site outcomes coexist with stable substrate rankings
disposition: Retain as positive evidence of context dependence

question: Do available RBP measurements resolve residual site variation?
candidates_or_measurements: ENCODE eCLIP, PrismNet, RBPNet, bulk GTEx abundance and interactions
control_or_reference: Same-fold reference; randomized RBP identities, shuffled tissue vectors, matched noise
principal_outcome: No reproducible residual increment at the available cell-line and tissue-average resolution
disposition: Close tested bulk/cell-line formulation

question: Does bulk chromatin add substrate or site information?

control_or_reference: Same-fold reference; +1-Mb shifted-locus control; pair-level geometry reference
principal_outcome: Small liver AUPRC-only effect; no stable site or pair-level gain

question: Can other chromatin states be tested with matched coverage?

control_or_reference: Tissue-match and coverage feasibility audit
